definition: the regular trip between home and work or school
vi: việc đi lại hằng ngày (giữa nhà và nơi làm/học)
example: My commute from Surrey to downtown Vancouver takes about an hour by SkyTrain.

definition: buses, trains and other shared transportation run for the public
example: Taking public transit saves me money on gas and parking every month.

definition: to change from one bus or train to another during a trip
vi: chuyển tuyến, đổi xe (trong một chuyến đi)
example: You'll need to transfer to another bus at Commercial–Broadway Station.

definition: the busy time of day when most people travel to or from work
example: The bridge is always jammed during rush hour, so I leave home before 7 a.m.

definition: a situation where roads are too full of vehicles to move easily
example: The new bus lanes are meant to reduce traffic congestion on Highway 1.

definition: a different, usually longer route used when the normal road is closed
vi: đường vòng, lộ trình thay thế
example: Because of the water main break, buses will take a detour along Main Street.

definition: a situation where a road cannot be used for a time
example: The weekend road closure is due to the annual marathon.

definition: a period when a normal service, such as trains, stops or does not work properly
example: TransLink warned riders about a service disruption on the Expo Line this weekend.

definition: the money you pay to travel on a bus, train, plane or taxi
example: Young children ride for free, and seniors pay a reduced fare.

definition: to share a car with others travelling to the same place
example: Three of us carpool to the warehouse to save on gas and parking.

definition: an official card that allows you to drive
vi: giấy phép lái xe, bằng lái
example: Newcomers to BC must exchange their foreign driver's licence within 90 days.

definition: a contract that pays for costs if your car is damaged or you cause an accident
example: In BC, basic car insurance is provided by ICBC.

definition: an official document that allows you to park in a certain area
example: Residents can apply for a parking permit to park on their street overnight.

definition: a notice that you must pay a fine for parking illegally
vi: vé phạt đỗ xe sai quy định
example: I got a parking ticket because the meter expired while I was at the dentist.

definition: to be behind schedule and likely to arrive late
example: Sorry, I'm running late because the ferry left twenty minutes behind schedule.

definition: to arrive too late to catch a bus
example: If I miss the bus at 7:15, the next one doesn't come for half an hour.
collocations: miss the bus by a minute
synonyms: be too late for the bus

definition: to take someone somewhere in your car
vi: chở ai đó (bằng xe), cho đi nhờ xe
example: My neighbour offered to give me a ride to the airport on Sunday morning.
collocations: give someone a ride to work
offer to give someone a ride

definition: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there
example: I drop off my daughter at daycare before I drive to the office.

definition: a list showing when buses, trains or ferries leave and arrive
example: Check the ferry timetable before you go, because the schedule changes in winter.

definition: designed so people using wheelchairs can enter and use it
vi: có lối đi dành cho xe lăn, thuận tiện cho người dùng xe lăn
example: All SkyTrain stations are wheelchair accessible, with elevators to the platforms.

definition: a part of a road marked only for bicycles
vi: làn đường dành cho xe đạp
example: The city added a protected bike lane along the waterfront last spring.

definition: a person walking, especially in a street
example: Drivers must stop for any pedestrian waiting at a marked crosswalk.

definition: the amount of money spent on gas or other fuel
vi: chi phí nhiên liệu, tiền xăng
example: Rising fuel costs have made many delivery companies raise their prices.

definition: to pay to use a car for a short time
example: We decided to rent a car for our trip to the Okanagan instead of taking the bus.
collocations: rent a car at the airport
rent a car for the weekend

definition: (of a machine or vehicle) to stop working
example: If your car breaks down on the Coquihalla in winter, you may wait hours for a tow truck.

definition: a tire that has lost its air
vi: lốp xe bị xẹp, bể bánh xe
example: I was late for work because I got a flat tire on the way.

definition: a service that helps drivers whose cars break down on the road
vi: dịch vụ cứu hộ giao thông
example: Luckily, my membership includes roadside assistance, so the tow was free.

definition: a journey to a place and back again
example: We made the round trip to Kelowna in one day, which was exhausting.

definition: the building and dock where people get on and off ferries
example: Arrive at the ferry terminal early on long weekends, or you may miss your sailing.

definition: to be unable to move because of heavy traffic
example: If you get stuck in traffic on the Port Mann Bridge, you could easily miss your flight.
collocations: get stuck in traffic for an hour
synonyms: be caught in a traffic jam

definition: to go somewhere in a vehicle to collect a person
example: Could you pick me up at the station around six? My bus gets in at 5:45.
collocations: pick someone up at the airport

definition: a card or ticket that lets you use buses and trains for a period of time
vi: vé/thẻ đi phương tiện công cộng (theo kỳ)
example: My employer pays for half of my monthly transit pass, so I rarely drive to work.

definition: a marked place on a road where people can walk across
vi: vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ
example: Slow down near schools and always stop for children crossing at the crosswalk.

definition: a place where two or more roads cross each other
example: The accident happened at a busy intersection during the morning rush.

definition: the fastest speed that drivers are legally allowed to drive on a road
example: The city lowered the speed limit on residential streets to make them safer for children.

definition: an area, usually outdoors, where cars can be parked
example: The parking lot at the community centre fills up quickly on Saturday mornings.

definition: a ticket for travelling to a place but not back again
example: I bought a one-way ticket to Victoria because my friend will drive me back on Sunday.

definition: a strap in a vehicle that holds you in your seat in case of an accident
example: Everyone in the car, including passengers in the back, must wear a seat belt.

definition: the practical driving exam that you must pass to get a driver's licence
vi: bài thi lái xe trên đường
example: Minh failed his first road test because he forgot to check his blind spot when changing lanes.

definition: to get on a bus in time before it leaves
example: If I leave the office by five, I can catch a bus that gets me home before dinner.

definition: to happen or arrive later than planned
example: All trains on the line are delayed by about twenty minutes because of a signal problem.

definition: one scheduled trip of a ferry
example: Due to high winds, the 3 p.m. sailing from Horseshoe Bay has been cancelled.

definition: to join traffic from another lane or road
example: It's hard to merge onto the highway when traffic is moving fast and nobody slows down.

definition: to let other vehicles or people go first
example: Drivers turning left must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

definition: to move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop
example: The police officer asked the driver to pull over because one of his headlights was out.
synonyms: stop at the side of the road

definition: a formal request to an insurance company to pay for damage or loss
vi: yêu cầu bồi thường bảo hiểm
example: After the collision, I called my insurer to file an insurance claim for the damage to my bumper.

definition: to have your vehicle pulled away by a tow truck, often because it was parked illegally or broke down
example: Don't park in the loading zone, or your car will get towed.

definition: special tires that grip better on snow and ice
example: Make sure you have winter tires before driving over the mountain passes in December.

definition: how safe or difficult it is to drive on roads because of weather or repairs
example: Check the road conditions before you leave, because snow is expected on the Coquihalla tonight.

definition: a bus that travels back and forth between two places, such as a station and an event
example: A free shuttle bus runs every fifteen minutes between the parking lot and the festival grounds.

definition: at a time when fewer people are travelling
example: Travelling off-peak is more comfortable because you can usually find a seat.

definition: a parking area near a transit station where you leave your car and continue by bus or train
vi: bãi đỗ xe để chuyển sang phương tiện công cộng
example: I drive to the park and ride in Langley and take the bus the rest of the way downtown.

definition: the metal sign on the front and back of a vehicle that shows its registration number
example: A witness wrote down the licence plate of the car that drove away after the accident.

definition: to put as much fuel into a vehicle as it can hold
example: Gas is cheaper outside the city, so I usually fill up the tank before I come back.
collocations: fill up the tank before a trip

definition: a service that lets members rent a car for short periods, often by the minute or hour
vi: dịch vụ chia sẻ xe ô tô
example: Since joining a car-sharing service, we've sold our second car and saved a lot on insurance.

definition: an accident in which a vehicle hits another vehicle, a person or an object
example: Two lanes of the bridge are closed after a collision involving a truck and two cars.

definition: to suddenly drive into the space in front of another vehicle, leaving too little room
example: A pickup truck cut me off on the highway, and I had to brake hard to avoid hitting it.

definition: not working or not available for use
example: The elevator at the station is out of service, so riders using wheelchairs should go to the next stop.

definition: a minor car accident with little damage and no injuries
example: I had a small fender bender in the mall parking lot, but luckily nobody was hurt.

definition: responsible for an accident or a problem
example: The insurance company decided that the other driver was at fault because he ran a red light.

definition: a thin, almost invisible layer of ice on a road that makes it very slippery
vi: lớp băng mỏng trong suốt trên đường
example: Several cars slid off the road this morning because of black ice on the overpass.

definition: to walk across a street at a place where it is not allowed or when the light is red
vi: băng qua đường sai quy định
example: People often jaywalk on this block because the nearest crosswalk is far away.

definition: using an app to book a private driver to take you somewhere
example: Ride-hailing apps are convenient late at night when buses run less often.

definition: to be left in a place without a way to leave
example: Hundreds of passengers were stranded at the terminal after the evening sailings were cancelled.
synonyms: be left without a way home

definition: to send traffic or vehicles along a different way than usual
example: Buses will be rerouted along Main Street while the parade is taking place.

definition: with so much traffic that cars are very close together and barely moving
vi: xe nối đuôi nhau, kẹt cứng
example: Traffic was bumper-to-bumper all the way across the bridge, so I was an hour late.

definition: driving while doing something else, such as using a phone, that takes your attention off the road
example: Police say distracted driving, especially texting, is a major cause of crashes in the province.

definition: the legal right to go first at a crossing or intersection
example: Pedestrians in a crosswalk have the right of way, so drivers must wait for them.
collocations: give someone the right of way
fail to yield the right of way

definition: an area around a vehicle that the driver cannot see in the mirrors
example: Always shoulder-check for cyclists in your blind spot before you turn right.

definition: using only a small amount of fuel to travel a long distance
example: We traded our old SUV for a more fuel-efficient hybrid to cut our commuting costs.

definition: to be delayed
vi: bị chậm trễ, bị kẹt lại
example: Sorry I'm late; I was held up by an accident on the highway.

definition: for an insurance company to decide that a damaged vehicle is not worth repairing (also used for cancelling a debt or treating money as a loss)
vi: (xe) bị bảo hiểm xác định hư hỏng toàn bộ, không đáng sửa
example: My car was written off after the crash, so I have to start shopping for a new one.

definition: a crash in which two vehicles driving towards each other hit front to front
example: The highway was closed for hours after a head-on collision near Hope.
collocations: be involved in a head-on collision

definition: driving after drinking alcohol or using drugs
vi: lái xe khi say rượu hoặc dùng chất kích thích
example: Police will set up checkpoints over the holidays to stop impaired driving.

definition: on the way to a place
example: The ferry is en route to Nanaimo but will arrive about forty minutes late.

definition: to drive too closely behind another vehicle
example: The truck was tailgating me on the highway, so I moved into the right lane to let it pass.

definition: a situation in which traffic cannot move at all
example: A stalled truck on the bridge caused gridlock across the downtown core.
